name: Index-Parameterized Matrix Sum
description: I replaced the static zero-product constraint with a dynamic determinant constraint on a linear combination of the state matrices, parameterized by the node indices u and v. The matrices are constructed via a similarity transform such that the determinant of the combined matrix evaluates to 0 if the modes are the same, and 6uv if the modes are different. Since u, v >= 1, 6uv is strictly positive. This makes the constraint appear to depend on the specific edge endpoints, hiding the global 2-coloring structure from surface-level pattern matchers while preserving exact logical equivalence.
